content: If the parameter has the va lue GPT_MODE_SLEEP the function Gpt_SetMode shall not start a wakeup timer automatically. First, the user shall call Gpt_StartTimer to start a wakeup timer, after this the user shall call Gpt_SetMode with parameter GPT_MODE_SLEEP .
